name: proj-sprint-planning
description: Builds a sprint plan with one sprint goal written as an outcome, this sprint's capacity by role, the items the team selected with its own estimates, a definition of done check and the list of what was left out and why. Use for "run proj-sprint-planning", "sprint planning", "plan the next sprint", "write a sprint goal", "what fits in this sprint", "we were committed to too much", "sprint capacity", part of the AI for Project Management Pack by 90n.
